history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1814 in Missouri and came to Chicago about 1869. He works as a waiter, and the household lives on the South Side near Clark Street. The family's church is Quinn Chapel.
